key.name: coins
key.description: JSON object with a coins array of watchlist entries. Empty until first-run seed.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh prices. Minimum 20s.

key.name: max-panel-coins
key.summary: Max coins on the top bar
key.description: How many coins can be pinned to the panel at once (1–8).

key.name: show-icons
key.summary: Show coin icons on the top bar
key.description: When false, only ticker names and prices are shown on the panel.

key.name: show-tickers
key.summary: Show ticker names on the top bar
key.description: When false, only icons and/or prices are shown.

key.name: colorize-prices
key.description: When false, all panel prices stay white. When true, up=green and down=red.

key.name: auto-compact
key.description: When 4+ coins are on the bar, hide tickers and show icon + price only. Off by default.

key.name: move-flash-threshold
key.description: Flash panel chip when absolute 24h change exceeds this percent. 0 = disabled.

key.name: alerts-enabled
key.description: Show a GNOME notification when a coin jumps quickly past the threshold between refreshes.

key.name: alert-threshold-pct
key.description: Notify when price moves this many percent up or down since the last sample (quick jump).

key.name: alert-up-enabled
key.description: Notify when price jumps upward past the threshold.

key.name: alert-down-enabled
key.description: Notify when price jumps downward past the threshold.

key.name: alert-cooldown-sec
key.description: Minimum seconds between notifications for the same coin.

key.name: alert-state
key.description: Internal map of coinId → {price, lastNotify} to avoid spam.

key.name: default-chart-provider
key.description: dexscreener, birdeye, or jupiter — used when a coin has no override.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Verbose API/cache logs in journalctl (prefix OldGrowthPriceTracker).

key.name: seeded
key.description: When true, an empty watchlist stays empty (user deleted everything).
